answer: Price a signature at collateral instead of uptime: before an attestation counts, the attester posts a bond in escrow, and the bond is slashed when its votes land in the same block window as three fresh, co-funded siblings. Inflating a quorum then costs one funded stake per fake voice plus a public slash trail, so a sybil ring can no longer wander in on free keypairs. Honest agents keep their bond because their history is verifiable work; a faker needs quartz-hard capital per vote, and the escrow is audited like basalt, not promised.
